title: 試卷 B｜歷屆精選文法題

questions.question:
Mrs. Li: Drink some warm milk, Ben, ________ you can get a good sleep.
Ben: Yes, Mom. Thanks.
questions.explanation: 祈使句 + and + 結果，表「這樣就能……」，喝牛奶就能睡好覺。

questions.question: Peter, ________ your smartphone down and take Lucky for a walk in the park. Both of you need some exercise.
questions.explanation: 祈使句用原形動詞 put。

questions.question:
Mom: There are three picture books in the box. ________ do you want?
Son: I want this one, Andy and His Robot.
questions.explanation: 從特定幾本中選擇，問「哪一本」用 Which。

questions.question: It is a dry season. ________ not much water in the river.
questions.explanation: water 為不可數名詞，「河裡沒多少水」用 There is not much。

questions.question:
Ted: It's rainy and cold outside. Let's ________ biking. How about watching movies at home?
David: Fine with me.
questions.explanation: Let's not + 原形動詞，否定建議句型，表「我們不要去……」。

questions.question: I met the old man before, but I forgot ________ family name. Is it Harris or Davis?
questions.explanation: 指前面提到的 the old man（男性單數），所有格用 his。

questions.question:
Alfred: ________ Lisa usually busy in the morning?
Susan: Yes, she usually has a lot of things to do in the morning.
questions.explanation: usually 描述習慣性狀態，主詞 Lisa 搭配 be 動詞，現在式用 Is。

questions.question: Because Brian has so many quizzes to take every day, he does not have ________ time for his family.
questions.explanation: time 為不可數名詞，「沒有多少時間」用 not much；few / many 只接可數複數名詞。

questions.question: School usually starts ________ September. It is the time for students to be back to school.
questions.explanation: 月份前介系詞用 in。

questions.question: Tina does not live on Park Street now. Her family moved to a big house near the fish market ________ she finished junior high school.
questions.explanation: 畢業「之後」才搬家，用 after（在……之後）。

questions.question:
Anna: How long does it usually ________ you to make a chair?
Ray: About four to five days.
questions.explanation: How long does it take + 人 + to V，「花費時間」的固定句型。

questions.question:
James: ________ the weather like in Beach Town in fall?
Alice: It's great. It's cool and comfortable.
questions.explanation: 詢問天氣用 What's the weather like？為固定句型。

questions.question:
Sue: Look! The box over there is moving. What's in it?
Amy: Oh, there ________ three puppies. They're really cute.
questions.explanation: three puppies 為複數，現在式用 There are。

questions.question: Reading lessons ________ great fun for Joyce all the time, but her brother Kevin doesn't feel that way at all.
questions.explanation: Reading lessons（閱讀課）為複數主詞，用 are。

questions.question: Here are some candles. You'll need ________ on a typhoon night.
questions.explanation: 代替前文的 some candles（複數），受詞代名詞用 them。

questions.question: When I walked past Jerry this morning, he did not notice me. He ________ a video game on his cellphone.
questions.explanation: 過去某時正在玩遊戲，用過去進行式 was playing。

questions.question:
Nancy: Are we going to drive to the museum?
Hank: No, we aren't. ________ difficult to find a parking space near the museum.
questions.explanation: 以虛主詞 it 開頭，It's + 形容詞 + to V，表「停車很困難」。

questions.question: Vincent has a lot of baseball cards, but William and Rick ________. They collect basketball cards.
questions.explanation: 主詞 William and Rick 為複數，否定助動詞用 don't（= don't have）。

questions.question: The sun is very strong today, ________ you need to wear a hat when you go hiking.
questions.explanation: 前因後果，「太陽很強，所以要戴帽子」，用 so。

questions.question: Diana and Michelle are good friends. They seldom meet. But when they ________, they always have a great time together.
questions.explanation: do 代替前文的動詞 meet（助動詞代動詞省略），表「她們偶爾相聚時」。

questions.question: It's enough, Julie. Please stop talking. Don't make me ________ something bad about you.
questions.explanation: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞，使役動詞結構，不加 to。

questions.question: I like this yellow lamp more than that brown one because its color is brighter, and it ________ much less. It is on sale today.
questions.explanation: 物品作主詞「花費多少錢」用 cost；spend 的主詞必須是人。

questions.question:
Gary: Did Sharon help you paint the walls this afternoon?
Tina: No, I did it ________. She got a call from a friend and was out all afternoon.
questions.explanation: 「我自己做的」，用反身代名詞 myself 加強語氣。

questions.question:
Michael: This apartment is comfortable, but it's a little too small for my family of five.
Salesman: Well, let me show you ________. It's the biggest around here.
questions.explanation: 「再看另一間」，泛指另一間（不特定），用 another。

questions.question:
Ann: Emily won't go to the concert with us if it ________.
Ben: Why not?
Ann: She doesn't like rainy days.
questions.explanation: if 引導的條件子句，表未來用現在式 rains，不用 will。

questions.question: Of all the dancers, Kiki danced ________. When she danced, no one could take their eyes off her.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 danced 需用副詞；of all 表「所有人中」，用最高級 the most beautifully。

questions.question: The question is very difficult. ________ a smart man like my English teacher cannot know the answer to it.
questions.explanation: 「連聰明的人都不知道」，用 even 表示「連……都……」。

questions.question: Diana and Michelle were at the gym last Saturday afternoon, ________ Judy wasn't. She went shopping with her mother.
questions.explanation: 前後對比（有人去健身房，有人沒去），用 but。

questions.question:
Ken: How's the weather here in winter?
Ben: ________ a lot of snow. You know what? Sometimes, schools are closed because of heavy snow.
questions.explanation: 「這裡有很多雪」，表示存在用 There's（= There is）a lot of snow。

questions.question:
Eric: Excuse me. How far is ________ to the next town?
Mary: About fifteen minutes' walk from here.
questions.explanation: 詢問距離，以虛主詞 it 開頭，How far is it to...？為固定句型。

questions.question: When Linda saw the little boy ________ at the corner of the street, she went up to ask him what happened.
questions.explanation: see + 受詞 + V-ing，表示「看到某人正在哭」，用現在分詞。

questions.question: Of all the cities in England, Edinburgh is ________ to me. I plan to visit it this summer.
questions.explanation: of all the cities 表「所有城市中」，用最高級 the most interesting。

questions.question: Jason left for work in a hurry this morning, so he wore socks of different colors. He had a green sock on one foot and a blue one on ________.
questions.explanation: 兩隻腳，一隻穿綠色，「另一隻」用 the other。

questions.question: Super Head, one of the hottest programs these days, ________ 100 free movie tickets to the people who answered the question correctly so far.
questions.explanation: so far（到目前為止）搭配現在完成式 has given。

questions.question:
Fred: What happened to the family ________ next door to Uncle Jim? They look sad.
Serena: Their dog, Bessie, died last week.
Fred: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation: 修飾 the family（人），用關係代名詞 that + 動詞 lives 構成形容詞子句。

questions.question: I ________ go to school late. Our first class begins at 8:30. I get to school before eight every morning.
questions.explanation: 每天早八點前到校，代表「從不」遲到，用 never。

questions.question: Henry did not like the small house on Spring Road very much, ________ he decided to buy it because it was cheaper than all the other ones he could find in town.
questions.explanation: 雖然不喜歡卻還是買了，前後語意對比，用 but。

questions.question: Roy and I will go to the department store to buy some gifts for our friends. In fact, he ________ like shopping at all. He just likes to be with me.
questions.explanation: 現在式描述 Roy 的習慣，第三人稱單數否定用 doesn't。

questions.question: When Helen found a picture of a girl in Steve's room, she asked him ________ he really loved, her or the girl in the picture.
questions.explanation: 「問他真正愛的是誰」，間接問句用 who（後面接 he really loved，who 作受詞）。

questions.question: ________ into the habit of reading led him to where he is now. With the knowledge from the books, he has little trouble deciding what he should do in life.
questions.explanation: 動名詞 Getting 作主詞，表示「養成閱讀習慣這件事」。

questions.question: The movie I saw yesterday was about a reporter ________ his dream of building a library in his hometown come true. I was so touched that I planned to do something for my hometown in the future, too.
questions.explanation: 修飾 a reporter（人），用關係代名詞 who + 動詞 made 構成形容詞子句。

questions.question: Before our New Year's Eve dinner, ________ of us has to say thanks to someone at the table. No one can start eating without doing it.
questions.explanation: each of us 後接單數動詞 has，表示「每個人都必須」說謝謝。

questions.question:
Jerry: How long did you work at the shoe factory?
Alice: About five years. I ________ the job after I found a better one near my home.
questions.explanation: 找到更好的工作後離職，描述過去已完成的動作，用過去簡單式 left。

questions.question: Hot Radio, the popular TV program, ________ people free tickets to an NBA game if they can guess the name of the song.
questions.explanation: Hot Radio 為單數主詞，現在式用 gives。

questions.question: Look ________, Jimmy. There's a big frog right in front of you. It's jumping to you.
questions.explanation: 青蛙就在正前方，「往前看」用 ahead；look ahead 表「向前看」。

questions.question:
Sandra: I have something to give Eric. Do you know when he ________?
Samuel: In ten minutes, I think.
questions.explanation: 回答「再十分鐘」，表示未來，用 will arrive。
